rules.name: Google Chrome cache
rules.why: Cached web files only, for every Chrome profile. Passwords, cookies, history, bookmarks and extensions are never touched.
sources: Chromium stores HTTP/code/GPU caches in each profile's Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache folders, separate from user data. https://www.chromium.org/developers/design-documents/network-stack/disk-cache/

rules.name: Microsoft Edge cache
rules.why: Cached web files only, for every Edge profile. Passwords, cookies, history, favorites and extensions are never touched.
sources: Edge is Chromium-based and uses the same per-profile Cache / Code Cache / GPUCache layout.

rules.name: Brave cache
rules.why: Cached web files only, for every Brave profile. Passwords, cookies, history and extensions are never touched.
sources: Brave is Chromium-based and uses the same per-profile cache layout.

rules.name: Vivaldi cache
rules.why: Cached web files only, for every Vivaldi profile. Passwords, cookies, history and extensions are never touched.
sources: Vivaldi is Chromium-based and uses the same per-profile cache layout.

rules.name: Opera cache
rules.why: Opera's cached web files. Passwords, cookies, history and extensions are never touched.
sources: Opera (Chromium-based) stores its disk caches under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Opera Software\Opera Stable.

rules.name: Opera GX cache
rules.why: Opera GX's cached web files. Passwords, cookies, history and extensions are never touched.
sources: Opera GX (Chromium-based) stores its disk caches under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Opera Software\Opera GX Stable.

rules.name: Firefox cache
rules.why: Firefox's disk and startup caches, for every profile. Passwords, cookies, history, bookmarks and add-ons are never touched.
sources: Firefox stores its network cache in each profile's cache2 folder and its startup cache in startupCache, both under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles.
